prompt: This watercolor illustration depicts a bustling school science fair. On the left, a girl with pigtails stands beside a volcano model erupting with red paint. Next to her, a boy in glasses points at the bubbling foam. In the center, a teacher with gray hair looks at a solar system display held by a student in a blue shirt. To the right, a cat sits on a table near a poster board showing plant growth. Beside the cat, a robot with wheels rests on the floor. A woman in a yellow dress hands a ribbon to the student in the blue shirt. Behind them, a man in a suit observes the scene. Near the entrance, a janitor with a mop leans against the wall. A bird perches on the window frame above the janitor. There is no digital screen visible in the room. There is no chalkboard present in the background.
